premise: Starfish is 'it' at hide and seek in the rock pool and finds everyone, even behind her: she has a tiny eye at the tip of each arm.
inspiration: The trickster-who-can't-be-fooled folk motif (the all-seeing guardian), made small and true: the 'magic' is how starfish are made.
lesson: Everyone has their own surprising way of seeing the world.
learning: A starfish has a tiny eye at the tip of each arm.

en-US.title: Eyes on the Tips
en-US.text: [excited] Hide and seek in the rock pool! {starfish:enter} Starfish was counting. {starfish:pulse} One, two, three, four, five! {shrimp:enter} Shrimp {sfx:dart} zipped behind a stone. {fish:enter} Little Fish hid right behind Starfish, {fish:go to starfish} at her back. {fish:face happy} [whispers] She'll never see me here. [short pause] But Starfish lifted one arm {starfish:live wave} and waved it about. {starfish:face happy} Found you, Little Fish! {fish:face surprised} {fish:wobble} How? Then she pointed another arm at the stone. And you, Shrimp! {shrimp:live flick} Shrimp twitched her feelers and flicked her tail. {shrimp:face surprised} [curious] How do you DO that? {starfish:live laugh} Starfish giggled. At the tip of every arm I have a tiny eye. Five arms, five little eyes. They can't see much… but they can see you! {fish:face happy} {shrimp:face happy} My turn to count, said Little Fish. And this time he hid… right in front of her. {starfish:hearts} [laughs]

es-ES.title: Ojos en las puntas
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Al escondite en la charca! {starfish:enter} Estrella contaba. {starfish:pulse} ¡Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco! {shrimp:enter} Gamba {sfx:dart} se escondió de un salto detrás de una piedra. {fish:enter} Pececito se puso detrás de Estrella, {fish:go to starfish} justo a su espalda. {fish:face happy} [whispers] Aquí no me ve. [short pause] Pero Estrella levantó un brazo {starfish:live wave} y lo movió de aquí para allá. {starfish:face happy} ¡Te pillé, Pececito! {fish:face surprised} {fish:wobble} ¿Cómo? Luego apuntó otro brazo hacia la piedra. ¡Y a ti, Gamba! {shrimp:live flick} Gamba movió las antenas y sacudió la cola. {shrimp:face surprised} [curious] ¿Cómo lo HACES? {starfish:live laugh} Estrella se rió. En la punta de cada brazo tengo un ojito. Cinco brazos, cinco ojitos. No ven mucho… ¡pero a vosotros sí! {fish:face happy} {shrimp:face happy} Ahora cuento yo, dijo Pececito. Y esta vez se escondió… justo delante de ella. {starfish:hearts} [laughs]

ja-JP.title: うでの さきっぽに 目
ja-JP.text: [excited]潮だまりで、かくれんぼ！{starfish:enter}ヒトデさんが、かぞえます。{starfish:pulse}いーち、にーい、さーん、しーい、ごーお！{shrimp:enter}エビさんは、{sfx:dart}ぴゅっと石のうしろへ。{fish:enter}おさかなくんは、ヒトデさんの{fish:go to starfish}すぐうしろにかくれました。{fish:face happy}[whispers]ここなら、ぜったい見つからないぞ。[short pause]ところがヒトデさんは、うでをいっぽん上げて、{starfish:live wave}ふりふり。{starfish:face happy}「おさかなくん、みーつけた！」 {fish:face surprised}{fish:wobble}「えっ、どうして？」 それから、べつのうでを石のほうへむけて、「エビさんも、みーつけた！」 {shrimp:live flick}エビさんは、ひげをぴくぴく、しっぽをぴしっ。{shrimp:face surprised}[curious]「どうして、わかるの？」 {starfish:live laugh}ヒトデさんは、くすくす。「うでのさきっぽに、小さな目がひとつずつあるの。うでが五本で、目も五つ。よくは見えないけど…あなたたちなら、見えるのよ！」 {fish:face happy}{shrimp:face happy}「こんどは、ぼくがかぞえるね！」 とおさかなくん。…といいながら、こんどはヒトデさんのまんまえに、かくれちゃいました。{starfish:hearts}[laughs]

de-DE.title: Augen an den Armspitzen
de-DE.text: [excited] Verstecken spielen im Tümpel! {starfish:enter} Der Seestern zählte. {starfish:pulse} Eins, zwei, drei, vier, fünf – ich komme! {shrimp:enter} Die Garnele {sfx:dart} huschte hinter einen Stein. {fish:enter} Das Fischchen versteckte sich direkt hinter dem Seestern, {fish:go to starfish} ganz dicht an seinem Rücken. {fish:face happy} [whispers] „Hier sieht er mich nie.“ [short pause] Aber der Seestern hob einen Arm {starfish:live wave} und schwenkte ihn hin und her. {starfish:face happy} „Hab dich, Fischchen!“ {fish:face surprised} {fish:wobble} „Wie denn?“ Dann zeigte er mit einem anderen Arm auf den Stein. „Und dich auch, Garnele!“ {shrimp:live flick} Die Garnele zuckte mit den Fühlern und schnippte mit dem Schwanz. {shrimp:face surprised} [curious] „Wie MACHST du das?“ {starfish:live laugh} Der Seestern kicherte. „An der Spitze von jedem Arm habe ich ein winziges Auge. Fünf Arme, fünf kleine Augen. Viel sehen sie nicht… aber euch sehen sie!“ {fish:face happy} {shrimp:face happy} „Jetzt zähle ich“, sagte das Fischchen. Und diesmal versteckte es sich… direkt vor dem Seestern. {starfish:hearts} [laughs]

fr-FR.title: Des yeux au bout des bras
fr-FR.text: [excited] Une partie de cache-cache dans la mare ! {starfish:enter} Étoile de mer comptait. {starfish:pulse} Un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq ! {shrimp:enter} Crevette {sfx:dart} a filé derrière un caillou. {fish:enter} Petit Poisson s’est caché juste derrière Étoile, {fish:go to starfish} tout contre son dos. {fish:face happy} [whispers] « Ici, elle ne me verra jamais. » [short pause] Mais Étoile a levé un bras {starfish:live wave} et elle l’a agité. {starfish:face happy} « Trouvé, Petit Poisson ! » {fish:face surprised} {fish:wobble} Comment ça ? Puis elle a pointé un autre bras vers le caillou. « Et toi aussi, Crevette ! » {shrimp:live flick} Crevette a remué ses antennes et donné un coup de queue. {shrimp:face surprised} [curious] « Mais comment tu FAIS ? » {starfish:live laugh} Étoile a pouffé de rire. « Au bout de chacun de mes bras, j’ai un tout petit œil. Cinq bras, cinq petits yeux. Ils ne voient pas grand-chose… mais vous, ils vous voient ! » {fish:face happy} {shrimp:face happy} « À moi de compter ! » a dit Petit Poisson. Et cette fois, il s’est caché… juste devant elle. {starfish:hearts} [laughs]

it-IT.title: Cinque braccia, cinque occhietti
it-IT.text: [excited] Si gioca a nascondino nella pozza! {starfish:enter} Stella marina contava. {starfish:pulse} Uno, due, tre, quattro, cinque! {shrimp:enter} Gamberetto {sfx:dart} è sfrecciato dietro un sasso. {fish:enter} Pesciolino si è nascosto proprio dietro Stella, {fish:go to starfish} alle sue spalle. {fish:face happy} [whispers] «Qui non mi vedrà mai.» [short pause] Ma Stella ha alzato un braccio {starfish:live wave} e l'ha mosso di qua e di là. {starfish:face happy} «Tana per Pesciolino!» {fish:face surprised} {fish:wobble} «Come hai fatto?» Poi ha puntato un altro braccio verso il sasso. «E tana per Gamberetto!» {shrimp:live flick} Gamberetto ha mosso le antenne e ha dato un colpo di coda. {shrimp:face surprised} [curious] «Ma come FAI?» {starfish:live laugh} Stella ha riso. «In punta a ogni braccio ho un occhietto. Cinque braccia, cinque occhietti. Non vedono granché… ma voi sì!» {fish:face happy} {shrimp:face happy} «Adesso conto io», ha detto Pesciolino. E questa volta si è nascosto… proprio davanti a lei. {starfish:hearts} [laughs]

zh-TW.title: 海星的小眼睛
zh-TW.text: [excited]潮池裡，玩躲貓貓囉！{starfish:enter}海星負責數數。{starfish:pulse}「一、二、三、四、五！」 {shrimp:enter}小蝦{sfx:dart}咻地躲到石頭後面。{fish:enter}小魚躲在海星的正後方，{fish:go to starfish}緊緊貼著牠的背。{fish:face happy}[whispers]「躲在這裡，海星一定看不到我。」 [short pause]可是，海星舉起一隻手臂，{starfish:live wave}揮呀揮。{starfish:face happy}「找到你了，小魚！」 {fish:face surprised}{fish:wobble}「怎麼會？」 接著，牠把另一隻手臂指向石頭。「還有你，小蝦！」 {shrimp:live flick}小蝦抖抖觸鬚，彈彈尾巴。{shrimp:face surprised}[curious]「你是怎麼辦到的？」 {starfish:live laugh}海星咯咯笑。「我每一隻手臂的尖尖上，都有一個小小的眼睛。五隻手臂，五個小眼睛。它們看得不太清楚……可是，看得到你們喔！」 {fish:face happy}{shrimp:face happy}「換我來數！」 小魚說。這一次，牠躲在……海星的正前面。{starfish:hearts}[laughs]

zh-HK.title: 手尖上的眼睛
zh-HK.text: [excited]石池裏玩捉迷藏啦！{starfish:enter}海星大聲說：「我嚟數！」 {starfish:pulse}「一、二、三、四、五！」 {shrimp:enter}小蝦{sfx:dart}咻一聲，躲到石頭後面。{fish:enter}小魚就躲在海星身後，{fish:go to starfish}緊緊貼着牠的背。{fish:face happy}[whispers]「匿喺呢度，佢一定見唔到我。」 [short pause]可是，海星舉起一隻手，{starfish:live wave}擺呀擺。{starfish:face happy}「捉到你喇，小魚！」 {fish:face surprised}{fish:wobble}「點解㗎？」 跟着，海星用另一隻手指着石頭。「仲有你，小蝦！」 {shrimp:live flick}小蝦抖抖觸鬚，彈彈尾巴。{shrimp:face surprised}[curious]「你點做到㗎？」 {starfish:live laugh}海星咯咯地笑：「我每隻手嘅尖尖，都有一隻細細嘅眼睛。五隻手，五隻小眼睛。睇得唔係好清楚……不過，見到你哋就夠喇！」 {fish:face happy}{shrimp:face happy}「輪到我數喇！」 小魚說。這一次，牠躲在……海星的正前面。{starfish:hearts}[laughs]

dart.prompt: a tiny quick splash of a small creature darting through a shallow rock pool, realistic
